title: Mojo and Building a CUDA Replacement with Chris Lattner (Software Engineering Daily)
summary: Lattner 回顾从 LLVM、Swift 到 Modular 的工程生涯，讲解 Mojo 的设计目标：Python 的易用性、C 的性能加上 Rust 的安全性。他的核心主张：AI 基础设施必须摆脱单一厂商绑定，同一份代码应能在不同厂商的 GPU 上高性能运行。
title_zh: Mojo 与打造 CUDA 替代品——对话 Chris Lattner（Software Engineering Daily）
role: Modular 联合创始人兼 CEO、LLVM/Swift/Mojo 作者
tags: ["Mojo","GPU 编程","编译器","AI 基础设施","厂商中立"]

transcripts.content:
Python is the dominant language for AI and data science applications, but it lacks the performance and low-level control needed to fully leverage GPU hardware. As a result, developers often rely on NVIDIA’s CUDA framework, which adds complexity and fragments the development stack.

Mojo is a new programming language designed to combine the simplicity of Python with the performance of C and the safety of Rust. It also aims to provide a vendor-independent approach to GPU programming. Mojo is being developed by Chris Lattner, a renowned systems engineer known for his seminal contributions to computer science, including LLVM, the Clang compiler, and the Swift programming language.

Chris is the CEO and Co-Founder of Modular AI, the company behind Mojo. In this episode, he joins the show to discuss his engineering journey and his current work on AI infrastructure and the Mojo language.

Kevin Ball or KBall, is the vice president of engineering at Mento and an independent coach for engineers and engineering leaders. He co-founded and served as CTO for two companies, founded the San Diego JavaScript meetup, and organizes the AI inaction discussion group through Latent Space.

Python 是人工智能和数据科学应用中的主流语言，但它缺乏充分发挥 GPU 硬件性能所需的执行效率与底层控制能力。因此，开发者往往依赖 NVIDIA 的 CUDA 框架，这增加了复杂性，也使开发栈趋于碎片化。

Mojo 是一门全新的编程语言，旨在融合 Python 的简洁性、C 语言的性能以及 Rust 的安全性。它还致力于提供一种与厂商无关的 GPU 编程方案。Mojo 由知名系统工程师 Chris Lattner 主导开发，他在计算机科学领域做出了诸多开创性贡献，包括 LLVM、Clang 编译器以及 Swift 编程语言。

Chris 是 Mojo 背后的公司 Modular AI 的联合创始人兼 CEO。在本期节目中，他做客节目，分享自己的工程生涯，以及目前在 AI 基础设施和 Mojo 语言方面的工作。

Kevin Ball（又称 KBall）是 Mento 的工程副总裁，同时也是一名面向工程师与工程管理者的独立教练。他曾联合创立两家公司并担任 CTO，创办了圣迭戈 JavaScript 技术聚会，并通过 Latent Space 组织 AI inaction 讨论小组。
